beats.cue: Casual status updates with real Linear + GitHub issue links. Continue, or ask CrewBot to summarize (pushes to Linear).
beats.suggest: summarize this meeting — what's most important?

messages.body: Quick update on where I am — JAM-5 is the main grind (MenuOCR confidence gate + TTS). Tracking it here too: https://github.com/gjamesd/conference-crew/issues/3 — Latin menus ~92%, stylized/low-light still ~71%, first-glyph p95 ~340ms vs 250ms bar.

Update on my side — JAM-7 wake-word + intents: https://github.com/gjamesd/conference-crew/issues/5 — WWv3 helped (~35% fewer false accepts) but open-office false wakes still ~2.1/hr. read_menu / whats_around / stop are working on-device.

Where I’m at — JAM-9 categorizer: https://github.com/gjamesd/conference-crew/issues/7 — 0.81 F1 on phone proxies, but we only have ~40 labeled glasses dining clips. When OCR/ASR are empty I just emit unknown and it looks broken.
Also still chewing JAM-5 details: only TTS if OCR conf ≥ 0.72. Biggest blocker is thermal — when Sam’s ASR is hot, OCR gets deferred and the menu path dies mid-demo.

Privacy update on JAM-8: https://github.com/gjamesd/conference-crew/issues/6 — no continuous cloud audio. Tap-to-share only. I need a speech_active signal from Alex so OCR can yield while people are talking.

I’m blocked on JAM-10 fusion until the feature bus is stable: https://github.com/gjamesd/conference-crew/issues/8 — need ocr_tokens + asr_intent + confidences from you two. Please don’t let live translation sneak into this sprint.

beats.title: More detail on each lane
beats.cue: More “where I’m at” detail. Continue, summarize → Linear, or ask for a sprint JSON push.
beats.suggest: summarize this meeting — what's most important?

messages.body: For JAM-5 I’m calling acceptance: ≥85% top-3 dish lines on 20 golden menus, p95 <250ms with ASR idle, false-speak <5%. Not doing handwriting/CJK/AR underlines on this ticket.
Parallel lane JAM-6 font pack + thermal yield: https://github.com/gjamesd/conference-crew/issues/4 — mostly packaging. Depends on Sam’s speech_active from the audio work.
JAM-7 acceptance I’m aiming for: cafe false-wake ≤1.2/hr, read_menu precision ≥0.9, max 3 wakes/min + LED. I’ll publish speech_active + endpoint events by Wednesday for Alex/Jordan.
On JAM-8 — zero audio bytes leave device unless tap confirmed. Demo builds get cloud feature-flagged OFF; QA should mitm that.
JAM-9 bar: dining recall ≥0.75, never label below 0.55 conf, prefer unknown over wrong. Cutting 10-way taxonomy / translation / social suggestions.
JAM-10 plan: late-fuse OCR keywords + ASR intent + motion prior → {label, confidence}. If JAM-5 OCR conf is high we can heuristic-force dining for the demo.
Sam — without speech_active this week, JAM-5/JAM-6 keep fighting ASR for thermal headroom.
Yep — committed. speech_active + asr_intent enums by Wednesday for JAM-10.

beats.title: Risks and cuts
beats.cue: Risks/cuts in plain language. Good time to push a sprint plan to Linear (JAM-11).
beats.suggest: create a sprint planning document and JSON from this meeting

messages.body: Risks as I see them: dataset gap on JAM-9 (high), thermal fight JAM-5↔JAM-7 (high), someone reopening cloud on JAM-8 (critical), stylized menus on JAM-5 (medium).
If we only get 70%: keep JAM-5 MenuOCR+TTS, then speech yield on JAM-6. Font pack can slip. Debug overlay slips.
My 70%: JAM-8 privacy stub + on-device intents, then JAM-7 wake cap/LED, then false-wake tuning. Long-form dictation is cut.
Mine: dining heuristic from strong JAM-5 OCR, then JAM-9 thresholds, eval harness after. Full transit class can wait.
Please formally cut hands-free sign translation so it doesn’t get dumped onto JAM-5 mid-sprint.
Same for continuous cloud ASR / always-listening analytics — leave that language on JAM-8 and in the planning doc.
Can CrewBot dump a sprint packet into JAM-11 with owners, out-of-scope, risks, and the 70% order?

beats.title: Ask for the planning dump
beats.cue: Ask CrewBot for summary or sprint JSON — both push to JAM-11 and comment on JAM-5…JAM-10.
beats.suggest: create a sprint planning document and JSON from this meeting

messages.body: Yeah — have CrewBot write markdown + JSON to JAM-11 and ping the workstream issues.
Call owners clearly: me on JAM-5/JAM-6, Sam on JAM-7/JAM-8, Jordan on JAM-9/JAM-10. Include the Wednesday speech_active dependency.
And spell out JAM-8 privacy constraints in the JSON so PM can’t quietly reopen cloud audio.
After that we can keep talking dogfood — Thu cafe test, Fri dry-run.
Dogfood stuff: I’ll bring 5 menu cards; Sam bring the noise playlist; Jordan bring the dining/unknown labeling sheet.
If CrewBot drafts that packet to JAM-11 now, we stop re-arguing scope every day.

messages.body: Schedule I’m proposing for the sync doc: Thu 4pm cafe test, Fri 11am leadership dry-run, Mon ship candidate if gates pass.
I’ll freeze the JAM-5 MenuOCR checkpoint Wednesday EOD after speech_active lands. No model swaps after Thu cafe unless it’s P0.
JAM-8 stays cloud-off in the demo build; QA checklist should prove zero egress.
I’ll publish JAM-9 eval Friday morning — dining recall + unknown rate. If recall <0.7 we stay heuristic-only for the demo.
JAM-6 risk: font license ETA Friday. If blocked, ship sans-only and note it on JAM-11.
Cool — ask CrewBot to refresh the sprint JSON on JAM-11 with schedule + that legal risk when you’re ready.
